comments.text: God has bestowed His blessings upon the people of Guyana.

comments.author: @colinstephenson2076
comments.text: I had to return to Guyana because I faced security threats living alone abroad after my children grew up and moved off to their own families. I got a job from 2021 to 2023 and I left it with the hope of getting a better after graduation in Computer Science. However, the new job never appeared. It seams as if Guyana is not totally ready for the digital innovations. Some people ask what can a Computer Science professional do. Others say old people have no place on the market. A CV to the president's office yielded nil. Several applications to many different job openings in Guyana are always turned down. I do feel lost.
